purpose: Interactive Fiction Weaver compilation of a Zyphos ecological power dispute from threadwing courier Reed-in-Crosswind's local perspective, using a ritual workplace-comedy tone with political stakes.

local_awareness_summary.text: Reed knows the Lower Lantern Shelf's roost compact, flight gaps, nectar wells, lantern signals, fungal payments, gamete-cradle routine, cargo chemistry, and current courier reputations.

Reed can taste pressure, static, heat, chemical gradients, and memory residue through ribbonlike sensory vanes, but cannot read the Matriarch's private intent or guarantee how another ecological party will answer.
The disputed Lowwater packet is viable but time-sensitive; full route closure also removes pollination and disease reporting because those functions share the same courier path.

frame_controls.text: Playable perspective stays with Reed's embodied threadwing perception. Choices use flight, landing, vane display, tasting, route song, gripping feet, and cargo placement rather than Airawa-style speech or omniscient network control.
The opening establishes routine compact work before the Matriarch presents a lineage refusal disguised as quarantine.

authority_boundaries.text: The Shelf Matriarch controls root warmth, nectar wells, cradle access, and its own gestation permission; it does not own courier decisions, lantern route light, fungal testimony, or Lowwater cargo custody.
source_refs: Eusocial Interbeing/Biosphere/Decomposers and Recyclers/Candle Fungal Roads.md

authority_boundaries.text: Tavi can braid public contract terms and witness ecological signals, but cannot turn a tree request into courier consent or seize Lowwater's packet through narration.

object_custody.text: The violet closure braid begins on the center contract table; Lowwater-Blue retains the gamete-packet sling unless a final successful relay explicitly transfers it to Reed; salt grit, shed fibers, and narrow quarantine strands stay where the Ink places them.

required_semantics.text: Every settlement must expose the linked reproductive, pollination, nourishment, warning, nest-shelter, and route-reputation consequences of ecological leverage.
Endings distinguish narrow quarantine, courier withdrawal, full embargo, and rival relay, each with a state-gated success or cost outcome.

forbidden_resolutions.text: Do not let the Matriarch command every species as one mind or make any biological signal an infallible diagnosis.
Do not treat a full birth-route embargo as affecting reproduction alone; the shared route must carry food-web and warning losses.

branch_and_fold_plan.summary: Four choice layers fold through routine, closure pressure, coalition formation, and one of eight state-gated political-ecological endings.

branches.actor_intent: Bind all three nursery roosts into one visible constituency before pressure arrives.
state_basis: Threadwing shed fibers retain route testimony and can be braided into warning or social markers.
reviewed_consequences: Raises roost_cohesion and nest_safety while time spent preening lowers gamete_viability; later assembly and packet outcomes read all three.

branches.actor_intent: Compare Matriarch nectar chemistry with sealed gestation cargo before accepting a later quarantine claim.
state_basis: Threadwing vanes read chemistry and memory residues; the Matriarch supplies nectar under the compact.
reviewed_consequences: Raises disease_evidence and matriarch_pressure; later closure prose and narrow-settlement gates read the comparison.

branches.actor_intent: Pay the fungal road for an independent route-health report.
state_basis: Candle roads exchange testimony for minerals and remembered credit.
reviewed_consequences: Raises fungal_credit and disease_evidence; later diagnosis choices and visible amber lines read both.

branches.actor_intent: Perform pollination service and establish standing with the route-lighting trees.
state_basis: Threadwings pollinate lantern trees; lantern knots signal route permission and closure.
reviewed_consequences: Raises lantern_consent and route_reputation; later witness, route-light, and relay gates read both.

branches.actor_intent: Make the closure braid's disease claim and lineage refusal legible to all three roosts.
state_basis: Courier vanes and shed-fiber routes can carry a message's chemical and social residues.
reviewed_consequences: Raises public_witness, route_reputation, matriarch_pressure, and limited embargo_scope; the folded scene makes the threatened nest cost visible.

branches.actor_intent: Recognize Lowwater-Blue as a protected courier and expose the packet's clean seal.
state_basis: Threadwings can land only on one faction's marker and use vane display as political testimony.
reviewed_consequences: Raises rival_access and public_witness while lowering nest_safety and sharply raising matriarch_pressure.

branches.actor_intent: Ask lantern partners to distinguish a cargo hold from closure of nourishment and warning traffic.
state_basis: Available only after lantern service has established consent.
reviewed_consequences: Spends lantern_consent, raises public_witness, sets a narrow embargo scope, and lowers gamete_viability through delay.

branches.actor_intent: Ask the paid fungal road whether the closure's sickness claim has material evidence.
state_basis: Available only with sufficient fungal credit; roads remember disease and traffic.
reviewed_consequences: Spends fungal_credit, raises disease_evidence and public_witness, and lowers gamete_viability through diagnostic delay.

branches.actor_intent: Make nest keepers and long-route couriers answer as one visible assembly.
state_basis: Threadwings maintain route songs, roost obligations, preferences, rivalries, and grudges.
reviewed_consequences: Raises roost_cohesion and public_witness while lowering nest_safety and gamete_viability as bodies leave warming work.

branches.actor_intent: Ask Tavi to bind only the disputed cargo while keeping every other route channel open.
state_basis: Airawa contract craft makes ecological obligations publicly legible.
reviewed_consequences: Sets narrow embargo_scope, raises public_witness and route_reputation, and increases matriarch_pressure.

branches.actor_intent: Move the packet to a diagnostic edge without transferring custody from Lowwater-Blue.
state_basis: Requires evidence and road standing; fungal roads can diagnose traffic while couriers own cargo decisions.
reviewed_consequences: Raises disease_evidence and rival_access, spends fungal_credit and gamete_viability, and preserves explicit packet custody.

branches.actor_intent: Trade full closure of Lowwater traffic for immediate warming of the three nesting hollows.
state_basis: The Matriarch controls nest shelter and has requested closure; the shared courier route also carries pollination and reports.
reviewed_consequences: Sets full embargo_scope, raises nest_safety, lowers route_reputation and rival_access, and temporarily lowers matriarch_pressure.

branches.actor_intent: Quarantine one cargo under plural witness without starving the shared route.
state_basis: Success requires narrow scope, credible evidence, public witness, and remaining packet viability.
reviewed_consequences: Routes to a plural compact or a procedural-delay cost ending based on accumulated state.

branches.actor_intent: Reject the false quarantine by moving all courier nests and services away from the Shelf.
state_basis: Success requires coherent roosts and route reputation sufficient to carry the refusal.
reviewed_consequences: Routes to a new courier alliance or a split-roost cost ending.

branches.actor_intent: Honor the Matriarch's full route embargo for a nesting season in exchange for shelter.
state_basis: Success requires explicit full scope, secured nests, and Matriarch pressure low enough to honor the exchange.
reviewed_consequences: Routes to a materially stable but harmful alliance or to a coercive bargain that fails to buy shelter.

branches.actor_intent: Move viable reproductive cargo through the eastern gap so Lowwater can seek another gestator.
state_basis: Success requires rival access, packet viability, and lantern route consent.
reviewed_consequences: Routes to a counter-alliance seed or a packet-loss cost ending.
